data: gallery clips (train baseline reagan_farewell_1989, val baseline eisenhower_farewell_1961, R2 readers); SELF section: fit-phase reader pickle (gettysburg and poetry fit sources, accent and ears validation sources); no test-split data

clean_regions.rule: related = the operation's target dimension plus each dimension whose measure the operation moves by at least 1.0 flag threshold (median over its clean trials, units within 2 words of the edit); applied to emphasis only

null_chain_reproduction_check.note: every null chain is an identity by construction (stretch 1, gain 0, pause 0, pause shortened to its own length, pitch spliced only where the tier changes), so it checks reproduction, not processing artefacts

instruments.configurations: round 1, pitch own (product) and contour (option); counts are [agree, rows]

level_a_weighted.note: the span check (A-weighted RMS over the re-aligned words, intended = the sum of the gains without ramps) was the first criterion; the frame check (same edited frames through the time map, intended gain curve with the editor's ramps and overlaps) was introduced in session 3 after the span check missed 5 rows; the tolerance (1.5 dB) did not change. The span check uses the aligner for its words.

recovery.contour_note: contour rows repeat the own rows for every operation that is not a pitch operation
